qa_issues: Meaning drift in item c: 'Peraturan Daerah tentang Pemberdayaan dan Perempuan' should be 'Regional Regulation on Women's Empowerment and Protection' (missing 'protection' and incorrect phrasing).

text:
WALIKOTA PANGKALPINANG
BAB I
KETENTUAN UMUM
Pasal 1
Dalam Peraturan Daerah ini yang dimaksud dengan: 1. Kota adalah Kota Pangkalpinang.
2. Pemerintah Kota adalah walikota sebagai unsur penyelenggara Pemerintahan Daerah yang memimpin pelaksanaan urusan pemerintahan yang menjadi kewenangan daerah otonom.
3. Walikota dalah Walikota Pangkalpinang
4. Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Daerah yang selanjutnya disingkat DPRD adalah Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Daerah Kota Pangkalpinang.
5. Perlindungan adalah segala upaya yang ditujukan  untuk memberikan rasa aman kepada perempuan yang dilakukan oleh pihak keluarga, advokat, lembaga sosial, kepolisian, kejaksaan, pengadilan, atau pihak lainnya baik sementara maupun berdasarkan penetapan pengadilan.
6. Pemberdayaan Perempuan adalah setiap upaya meningkatkan kemampuan fisik, mental spiritual,  sosial,pengetahuan, dan keterampilan agar perempuan  siap didayagunakan sesuai dengan kemampuan  masingmasing.
7. Diskriminasi terhadap Perempuan adalah setiap pembedaan, pengucilan atau pembatasan yang dibuat atas dasar jenis kelamin, yang mempunyai pengaruh atau tujuan untuk mengurangi atau menghapuskan pengakuan, penikmatan atau penggunaan hak-hak  asasi manusia dan kebebasan-kebebasan pokok di  bidang politik, ekonomi, sosial, budaya, sipil atau  apapun oleh kaum perempuan, terlepas dari status  perkawinan mereka, atas dasar persamaan antara laki laki dan perempuan.
8. Segala Bentuk Diskriminasi terhadap Perempuan adalah segala bentuk Diskriminasi yang meliputi dimensi  wilayah (daerah bencana, daerah konflik, daerah perbatasan, daerah tertinggal, daerah terpencil, dan lainnya), dimensi usia (usia produktif, usia lanjut, dan lainnya), dan dimensi khusus (penyandang cacat,  tenaga kerja, dan lainnya).
9. Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan adalah setiap tindakan yang melanggar, menghambat, meniadakan kenikmatan dan mengabaikan hak asasi perempuan.
10. Kekerasan dalam Rumah Tangga adalah setiap perbuatan terhadap seorang perempuan yang berakibat  timbulnya kesengsaraan atau penderitaan secara fisik,  seksual, psikologis, dan/atau penelantaran rumah  tanggal termasuk ancaman untuk melakukan perbuatan, pemaksaan, atau perampasan kemerdekaan secara melawan hukum dalam lingkup rumah tangga.
11. Penghapusan Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan adalah  jaminan yang diberikan oleh Pemerintah Daerah untuk  mencegah terjadinya kekerasan, menindak pelaku  kekerasan dan melindungi korban.
12. Penghapusan Kekerasan dalam Rumah Tangga adalah  jaminan yang diberikan oleh negara untuk mencegah  terjadinya kekerasan dalam rumah tangga, menindak  pelaku kekerasan dalam rumah tangga, dan melindungi  korban kekerasan dalam rumah tangga.
13. Korban adalah perempuan yang mengalami kesengsaraan dan atau penderitaan baik langsung maupun tidak langsung sebagai akibat dari kekerasan.
14. Pendamping adalah orang tua atau perwakilan dari  lembaga yang mempunyai keahlian melakukan pendampingan korban untuk melakukan konseling, terapi dan advokasi guna penguatan dan pemulihan diri  korban kekerasan.
15. Gender adalah konsep yang mengacu pada pembedaan  peran dan tanggung jawab laki-laki dan perempuan  yang terjadi akibat dari dan dapat berubah oleh  keadaan sosial dan budaya masyarakat.
16. Kesetaraan Gender adalah kesamaan kondisi bagi laki laki dan perempuan untuk memperoleh kesempatan  dan hak-haknya sebagai manusia, agar mampu  berperan dan berpartisipasi dalam kegiatan politik,  ekonomi, sosial budaya, pertahanan dan keamanan, dan  kesamaan dalam menikmati hasil pembangunan.
17. Keadilan Gender adalah suatu proses untuk menjadi adil terhadap laki- laki dan perempuan.
translated_text:
MAYOR OF PANGKALPINANG
CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. City is the City of Pangkalpinang.
2. City Government is the mayor as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of governmental affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Pangkalpinang.
4. Regional House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD, is the Regional House of Representatives of the City of Pangkalpinang.
5. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to women carried out by family, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily or based on a court determination.
6. Women's Empowerment is every effort to improve physical, mental-spiritual, social, knowledge, and skills capabilities so that women are ready to be utilized according to their respective abilities.
7. Discrimination against Women is any distinction, exclusion, or restriction made on the basis of sex, which has the effect or purpose of impairing or nullifying the recognition, enjoyment, or exercise of human rights and fundamental freedoms in the political, economic, social, cultural, civil, or any other field by women, regardless of their marital status, on the basis of equality between men and women.
8. All Forms of Discrimination against Women is all forms of Discrimination that include territorial dimensions (disaster areas, conflict areas, border areas, underdeveloped areas, remote areas, and others), age dimensions (productive age, elderly, and others), and special dimensions (persons with disabilities, workers, and others).
9. Violence against Women is any action that violates, obstructs, eliminates enjoyment, and disregards women's human rights.
10. Domestic Violence is any act against a woman that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or household neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty within the scope of the household.
11. Elimination of Violence against Women is a guarantee provided by the Regional Government to prevent the occurrence of violence, take action against perpetrators of violence, and protect victims.
12. Elimination of Domestic Violence is a guarantee provided by the state to prevent the occurrence of domestic violence, take action against perpetrators of domestic violence, and protect victims of domestic violence.
13. Victim is a woman who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Assistant (Pendamping) is a parent or representative from an institution that has the expertise to provide assistance to victims to conduct counseling, therapy, and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
15. Gender is a concept that refers to the differentiation of roles and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of and can be changed by the social and cultural conditions of society.
16. Gender Equality is the equality of conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings, to be able to play a role and participate in political, economic, socio-cultural, defense and security activities, and equality in enjoying the results of development.
17. Gender Justice is a process to be fair to men and women.
qa_issues: Scrambled numbering/list structure: list items are run together after the colon; should be clearly separated as items 1–17.

Minor meaning/term drift: 'Pendamping' translated as 'Companion' (should be 'Assistant/Companion (Pendamping)' or 'Assistant'); 'penelantaran rumah tanggal' refers to household neglect (typo in source) but translation is acceptable; add missing punctuation consistency (e.g., item 3 ends without period).

Scrambled/merged list formatting: several list markers (b./c., a./b./c., e./f., h./i.) are run together on the same line instead of being separated into distinct items, risking mis-association in downstream parsing.

text:
BAB IV
KEWAJIBAN DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB
PEMERINTAH DAERAH
Pasal 6
(1) Pemerintah Kota berkewajiban dan bertanggungjawab  terhadap penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan dan  perlindungan perempuan.
(2) Upaya pemberdayaan dan perlindungan perempuan  sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi:
a. penetapan kebijakan, program, dan kegiatan; b. penetapan pedoman pelaksanaan;
c. penyelenggaraan layanan; dan
d. koordinasi kebijakan, program dan kegiatan. (3) Upaya pemberdayaan dan perlindungaan perempuan  sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) dilakukan secara  terpadu.
translated_text:
CHAPTER IV
OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
OF REGIONAL GOVERNMENT
Article 6
(1) The City Government has the obligation and responsibility for the implementation of women's empowerment and protection.
(2) The efforts for women's empowerment and protection as referred to in paragraph (1) include:
   a. determination of policies, programs, and activities;
   b. determination of implementation guidelines;
   c. provision of services; and
   d. coordination of policies, programs and activities.
(3) The efforts for women's empowerment and protection as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be carried out in an integrated manner.
qa_issues: Scrambled list/numbering structure: items a–d and paragraph (3) are run together on the same line; list markers are not cleanly separated from their content

text:
Pasal 7
Dalam melaksanakan kebijakan, program dan kegiatan pemberdayaan dan perlindungan perempuan, Pemerintah  Kota dapat melakukan kerja sama dengan masyarakat/lembaga masyarakat.
translated_text:
Article 7
In implementing policies, programs and activities for the empowerment and protection of women, the City Government may cooperate with the community/community institutions.

text:
Pasal 11
Penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan perempuan dibidang politik dan pemerintahan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 8 huruf c meliputi:
a. pelibatan perempuan dalam pengambilan keputusan; b. pemberian kesempatan bagi perempuan untuk  menduduki jabatan publik;
c. partisipasi dalam pemilihan umum; dan
d. pengembangan diri melalui organisasi untuk berserikat,  berkumpul dan mengeluarkan pendapat.
translated_text:
Article 11
The implementation of women's empowerment in the field of politics and governance as referred to in Article 8 letter c includes:
a. involvement of women in decision-making; b. provision of opportunities for women to hold public office;
c. participation in general elections; and
d. self-development through organizations to associate, assemble and express opinions.

text:
Pasal 12
Penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan perempuan dibidang hukum  sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 8 huruf d meliputi: a. peningkatan kesadaran dan pengetahuan dibidang hukum melalui layanan komunikasi, informasi dan  edukasi; dan
b. fasilitasi akses dan layanan konsultasi hukum.
translated_text:
Article 12
The implementation of women's empowerment in the field of law as referred to in Article 8 letter d includes:
a. increasing awareness and knowledge in the field of law through communication, information and education services; and
b. facilitation of access and legal consultation services.

text:
Pasal 13
Penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan perempuan dibidang  pendidikan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 8 huruf e melalui:
a. penyelenggaraan pendidikan formal dan nonformal; b. pendidkan formal sebagaimana dimakud dalam huruf a  adalah sebagaimana yang diatur oleh pemerintah; dan c. pendidikan non formal sebagaimana dimaksud huruf a  meliputi pendidikan pemberdayaan perempuan,  pendidikan ketrampilan dan pelatihan kerja.
translated_text:
Article 13
The implementation of women's empowerment in the field of education as referred to in Article 8 letter e through:
a. implementation of formal and non-formal education; b. formal education as referred to in letter a is as regulated by the government; and c. non-formal education as referred to in letter a includes women's empowerment education, skills education and job training.

text:
Pasal 14
(1) Penyelenggaran perempuan dibidang kesehatan  sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 8 huruf f pelayanan  kesehatan guna menjalani kehidupan reproduksi dan kehidupan seksual yang sehat, aman serta bebas dari  paksaan dan / atau kekerasan.
(2) Pelayanan kesehatan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat  (1) meliputi:
a. pelayanan kesehatan masa sebelum hamil, saat  hamil, masa persalinan dan sesudah melahirkan; b. pengaturan kehamilan, pelayanan kontrasepsi dan  kesehatan seksual; dan
c. pelayanan kesehatan reproduksi.
(3) Pelayanan kesehatan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat  (1) dilaksanakan melalui pendekatan promotif, preventif,  kuratif dan rehabilitatif.
translated_text:
Article 14
(1) The implementation of women’s affairs in the health sector as referred to in Article 8 letter f is carried out through health services in order to undergo reproductive life and sexual life that is healthy, safe, and free from coercion and/or violence.
(2) Health services as referred to in paragraph (1) include:
 a. health services during the period before pregnancy, during pregnancy, during childbirth, and after giving birth;
 b. pregnancy regulation, contraceptive services, and sexual health; and
 c. reproductive health services.
(3) Health services as referred to in paragraph (1) are implemented through promotive, preventive, curative, and rehabilitative approaches.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/grammar: paragraph (1) missing the main verb/obligation (should state that the implementation/provision is carried out through health services).
Scrambled list structure: in paragraph (2) items a and b are merged on one line; item b should be a separate lettered point.

text:
Pasal 15
(1) Penyelenggaraan perempuan dibidang ketenagakerjaan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 8 huruf g memiliki  kesempatan yang sama tanpa adanya kesenjangan dan  perbedaan dengan kaum pria.
(2) Pemberi kerja memberikan perlindungan kepada pekerja  perempuan yang mencakup kesejahteraan, keselamatan  dan kesehatan.
translated_text:
Article 15
(1) The provision of employment for women as referred to in Article 8 letter g provides equal opportunities without any disparity or discrimination compared to men.
(2) Employers provide protection to female workers which includes welfare, safety and health.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/unnatural rendering: "implementation for women" should reflect "penyelenggaraan ... bagi perempuan" (provision/implementation of employment for women).
Meaning drift: "without any gaps and differences with men" should reflect "without inequality/disparity or discrimination compared to men" (kesenjangan dan perbedaan).

text:
Pasal 16
Penyelenggaran perempuan dibidang jaminan sosial  sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 8 huruf h, merupakan  tanggung jawab Pemerintah Kota dan harus menyediakan  fasilitas pembinaan serta memberikan hak jaminan sosial.
translated_text:
Article 16
The implementation for women in the field of social security as referred to in Article 8 letter h, is the responsibility of the City Government and must provide guidance facilities as well as grant social security rights.

text:
Bagian Kedua
Perlindungan Kesehatan
translated_text:
Second Part
Health Protection

text:
Pasal 19
(1) Perempuan mempunyai hak untuk mendapatkan perlindungan khusus dari hal yang mengancam keselamatan dan atau kesehatannya.
(2) Perlindungan khusus diberikan kepada perempuan karena fungsi reproduksinya dijamin dan dilindungi  oleh hukum.
(3) Pemerintah Daerah Kota memfasilitasi perlindungan  kesehatan sesuai dengan kemampuan keuangan  daerah.
(4) Bentuk perlindungan kesehatan bagi perempuan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3) diatur lebih lanjut dalam Peraturan Walikota.
translated_text:
Article 19
(1) Women have the right to obtain special protection from matters that threaten their safety and/or health.
(2) Special protection is given to women because their reproductive function is guaranteed and protected by law.
(3) The Municipal/City Local Government facilitates health protection in accordance with the region's financial capacity.
(4) The form of health protection for women as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be further regulated in a Mayor Regulation.
qa_issues: Minor meaning/terminology drift: "Mayoral Regulation" should be "Mayor Regulation" (Peraturan Walikota).
Minor meaning drift: "City Regional Government" should reflect "Municipal/City Local Government" (Pemerintah Daerah Kota).

text:
Bagian Ketiga
Perempuan pekerja/buruh
translated_text:
Third Part
Female workers/laborers

text:
Pasal 20
(1) Perempuan memiliki kesempatan yang sama tanpa diskriminasi untuk memperoleh pekerjaan dan  mengusahakan penghargaan yang layak atas pekerjaan (2) Kesempatan yang sama sebagaimana dimaksud pada  ayat (1) diwujudkan melalui pemenuhan perlindungan  hak tenaga kerja perempuan mendapatkan perlakuan  yang sama dari pengusaha.
(3) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai pemenuhan  perlindungan hak tenaga kerja perempuan sebagaimana  dimaksud pada ayat (2) diatur dalam Peraturan  Walikota.
translated_text:
Article 20
(1) Women have equal opportunities without discrimination to obtain employment and to pursue appropriate recognition for their work.
(2) Equal opportunities as referred to in paragraph (1) are realized through the fulfillment of protection of the rights of female workers to receive equal treatment from employers.
(3) Further provisions regarding the fulfillment of protection of the rights of female workers as referred to in paragraph (2) are regulated in a Mayoral Regulation.
qa_issues: Scrambled/merged numbering: paragraphs (1) and (2) are run together without a clear break, unlike the original structure.

text:
Bagian Keempat
Perempuan Lanjut Usia
translated_text:
Part Four
Elderly Women

text:
Pasal 21
(1) Pemerintah Kota memberikan perlindungan kepada perempuan lanjut usia yang tidak mandiri, sakit tidak mampu secara ekonomi agar dapat mewujudkan dan  menikmati taraf hidup yang wajar.
(2) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai bentuk perlindungan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) diatur dalam Peraturan Walikota.
translated_text:
Article 21
(1) The City Government provides protection to elderly women who are not independent, sick, and economically incapable so that they can realize and enjoy a decent standard of living.
(2) Further provisions regarding the form of protection as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated in a Mayoral Regulation.

text:
Bagian Kelima
Perempuan Penyandang Disabilitas
translated_text:
Fifth Part
Women with Disabilities

text:
Pasal 22
(1) Pelaksanaan perlindungan bagi perempuan penyandang  disabilitas dalam rangka memberikan perlindungan dan  pencegahan terhadap bentuk-bentuk diskriminasi  antara lain bebas dari perlakuan kejam, tidak  manusiawi, merendahkan martabat manusia dan bebas  dari eksploitasi.
(2) Perempuan penyandang disabilitas sebagaimana  dimaksud pada ayat (1) mendapatkan hak perlindungan  atas:
a. jaminan keberlangsungan dan pengembangan diri  pribadi;
b. partisipasi dibidang pendidikan, kesehatan,  pekerjaan, politik, olahraga, seni dan budaya serta  pemanfaatan teknologi informasi dan komunikasi;
c. aksesibilitas informasi, bantuan hukum, mobilitas,  layanan sosial; dan
d. upaya intervensi dini termasuk pengobatan dan  rehabilitasi untuk peningkatan fungsi dan  kapasitasnya.
translated_text:
Article 22
(1) The implementation of protection for women with disabilities in order to provide protection and prevention against forms of discrimination includes, among others, freedom from cruel treatment, inhuman treatment, degrading human dignity and freedom from exploitation.
(2) Women with disabilities as referred to in paragraph (1) shall receive the right to protection for:
a. guarantee of continuity and personal self-development;
b. participation in the fields of education, health, employment, politics, sports, arts and culture as well as the utilization of information and communication technology;
c. accessibility to information, legal aid, mobility, social services; and
d. early intervention efforts including treatment and rehabilitation for the improvement of their functions and capacities.

Bagian Keenam
Perempuan Tuna Wisma
translated_text:
Sixth Part
Homeless Women

text:
Bagian Ketujuh
Perempuan Pekerja Rumah Tangga
translated_text:
Seventh Part
Women Domestic Workers
qa_issues: Meaning drift: "Perempuan Pekerja Rumah Tangga" refers to women who are domestic workers (female domestic workers), not "Female Domestic Workers" as a category title is acceptable but better rendered as "Women Domestic Workers"/"Women Household Workers"; however the main issue is that "Pekerja Rumah Tangga" is "Domestic Workers" and "Perempuan" modifies the workers (women), so "Women Domestic Workers" is the closer legal heading translation.

text:
Pasal 24
(1) Pelaksanaan perlindungan bagi perempuan pekerja  rumah tangga dalam rangka memberikan perlindungan  dan pencegahan terhadap bentuk diskriminasi,  perlakuan kejam, tidak manusiawi, merendahkan  martabat manusia dan eksploitasi dalam hubungan  kerja.
(2) Perempuan pekerja rumah tangga sebagaimana  dimaksud pada ayat (1) mendapat perlindungan atas: a. pengakuan hak, upah dan kondisi kerja yang layak;  b. jaminan kesehatan dan sosial ketenagakerjaan;  c. akses informasi dan layanan konsultasi hukum; dan  d. kesempatan memperoleh pengetahuan dan  keterampilan untuk meningkatkan status ekonomi.
translated_text:
Article 24
(1) The implementation of protection for female domestic workers is intended to provide protection and prevention against forms of discrimination, cruel treatment, inhumane treatment, degradation of human dignity and exploitation in employment relations.
(2) Female domestic workers as referred to in paragraph (1) shall receive protection for: a. recognition of rights, wages and decent working conditions; b. health and social security guarantees for workers; c. access to information and legal consultation services; and d. opportunities to obtain knowledge and skills to improve economic status.

text:
Bagian Kedelapan
Perempuan Penyangga Ekonomi Keluarga
translated_text:
Eighth Part
Women as Economic Pillars of the Family

text:
Pasal 25
(1) Pelaksanaaan perlindungan bagi perempuan penyangga  ekonomi keluarga dalam rangka memberikan  perlindungan dan pencegahan terhadap bentuk  diskriminasi, stigma negatif dan pemberdayaan ekonomi  bagi perempuan penyangga ekonomi keluarga.
(2) Perempuan penyangga ekonomi keluarga sebagaimana  dimaksud pada ayat (1) mendapatkan hak perlindungan  atas:
a. tindakan diskriminasi dan upaya pelemahan fungsi  perempuan sebagai penyangga ekonomi keluarga;
b. penguatan kemampuan dan pengakuan sebagai  penyangga ekonomi keluarga di lingkungannya; dan  c. aksesibilitas terhadap lembaga ekonomi dan  keuangan.
translated_text:
Article 25
(1) The implementation of protection for women as family economic pillars is intended to provide protection and prevention against forms of discrimination, negative stigma and economic empowerment for women as family economic pillars.
(2) Women as family economic pillars as referred to in paragraph (1) shall receive the right to protection from:
a. discriminatory actions and efforts to weaken the function of women as family economic pillars;
b. strengthening of capacity and recognition as family economic pillars in their environment; and
c. accessibility to economic and financial institutions.

text:
Bagian Kesembilan
Perempuan Mantan Warga Binaan Lembaga Permasyarakatan
translated_text:
Ninth Part
Women Former Inmates of Correctional Institutions

text:
Pasal 26
(1) Pelaksanaan perlindungan bagi perempuan mantan  warga binaan Lembaga Pemasyarakatan dalam rangka  memberikan perlindungan dari hambatan untuk  menyesuaikan diri dalam kehidupan masyarakat dan dapat melaksanakan kehidupan secara normal.
(2) Perempuan mantan warga binaan Lembaga  Pemasyarakatan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1)  mendapatkan perlindungan atas:
a. rehabilitasi dan reintegrasi sosial; dan
b. kesempatan memperoleh pengetahuan dan  keterampilan untuk meningkatkan status ekonomi.
translated_text:
Article 26
(1) The implementation of protection for women former inmates of Correctional Institutions is intended to provide protection from obstacles to adjusting to life in society and to be able to carry out life normally.
(2) Women former inmates of Correctional Institutions as referred to in paragraph (1) receive protection for:
a. rehabilitation and social reintegration; and
b. opportunities to obtain knowledge and skills to improve economic status.

text:
Bagian Kesepuluh
Perempuan Korban Bencana
translated_text:
Tenth Part
Women Victims of Disaster

Article 27
(1) Implementation of protection for women victims of disaster in the context of providing protection during a disaster and post-disaster.
(2) Women victims of disaster as referred to in paragraph (1) receive protection for:
a. access to proper shelter;
b. health services;
c. information access services and legal consultation; and
d. post-disaster recovery
qa_issues: Scrambled list/numbering structure: item d is merged into item c line instead of being a separate list item.
Minor meaning drift/awkward rendering: "during disaster" should be "during a disaster" (perlindungan saat bencana).

text:
BAB VII
PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN KORBAN KEKERASAN
Bagian Kesatu
Umum
translated_text:
CHAPTER VII
PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
Part One
General

text:
Pasal 28
(1) Setiap perempuan korban kekerasan berhak  mendapatkan perlindungan, informasi, pelayanan  terpadu, penanganan berkelanjutan sampai tahap  rehabilitasi dan penanganan secara rahasia dari  individu, kelompok ataupun lembaga, Pemerintah Kota maupun masyarakat.
(2) Dalam hal terjadi kekerasan, setiap korban berhak mendapatkan pelayanan kesehatan dan pendampingan, baik secara psikologis maupun hukum serta  mendapatkan jaminan atas hak-haknya yang berkaitan  dengan statusnya sebagai perempuan.
translated_text:
Article 28
(1) Every female victim of violence has the right to obtain protection, information, integrated services, continuous handling up to the rehabilitation stage and confidential handling from individuals, groups or institutions, the City Government and the community.
(2) In the event of violence, every victim has the right to obtain health services and assistance, both psychologically and legally, and to obtain guarantees of their rights related to their status as a woman.

text:
Bagian Kedua
Kewajiban dan Upaya Pemerintah Daerah
translated_text:
Second Part
Obligations and Efforts of Regional Government

text:
Pasal 29
(1) Pemerintah Kota berkewajiban dan bertanggung jawab untuk melaksanakan upaya pencegahan terjadinya kekerasan terhadap perempuan dalam bentuk: a. mengumpulkan data dan informasi tentang korban kekerasan serta peraturan perundang-undangan; b. melakukan pendidikan tentang nilai-nilai anti kekerasan terhadap perempuan;
c. melakukan sosialisasi peraturan perundang undangan yang berkaitan dengan penyelenggaraan  perlindungan akan korban kekerasan;
d. melakukan pemantauan dan evaluasi terhadap penyelenggaraan perlindungan korban kekerasan;  dan
e. menyusun laporan terhadap penyelenggaraan perlindungan perempuan korban kekerasan.
(2) Untuk mengantisipasi terjadinya tindak kekerasan terhadap perempuan, Pemerintah Kota berkewajiban menyediakan dan menyelenggarakan layanan bagi  korban dalam bentuk:
a. mendirikan dan memfasilitasi terselenggaranya lembaga layanan terpadu untuk korban dengan melibatkan unsur masyarakat; dan
b. mendorong kepedulian masyarakat akan pentingnya perlindungan terhadap korban.
(3) Pemerintah Kota dalam melaksanakan kewajiban sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dan ayat (2) harus memperhatikan hak dan kewajiban orang tua, wali atau orang lain yang secara hukum bertanggung jawab terhadap korban.
translated_text:
Article 29
(1) The City Government has the obligation and responsibility to implement efforts to prevent the occurrence of violence against women in the form of: a. collecting data and information about victims of violence and laws and regulations; b. conducting education on anti-violence values against women;
c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the implementation of protection for victims of violence;
d. conducting monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of protection for victims of violence; and
e. preparing reports on the implementation of protection for women victims of violence.
(2) To anticipate the occurrence of acts of violence against women, the City Government has the obligation to provide and organize services for victims in the form of:
a. establishing and facilitating the operation of integrated service institutions for victims by involving community elements; and
b. encouraging community awareness of the importance of protection for victims.
(3) The City Government in carrying out the obligations as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) must pay attention to the rights and obligations of parents, guardians or other persons who are legally responsible for the victim.

text:
Bagian Ketiga
Bentuk Kekerasan dan Perlindungan
translated_text:
Third Part
Forms of Violence and Protection

text:
Pasal 30
(1) Bentuk kekerasan terhadap perempuan meliputi: a. kekerasan fisik;
b. kekerasan seksual;
c. kekerasan ekonomi; dan
d. kekerasan psikis.
(2) Bentuk kekerasan fisik sebagaimana dimaksud pada  ayat (1) huruf a berupa setiap perbuatan yang  mengakibatkan rasa sakit, cidera, luka atau cacat pada  tubuh seseorang, pingsan dan atau menyebabkan  kematian.
(3) Bentuk kekerasan seksual sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) huruf b berupa pelecehan seksual, pemaksaan hubungan seksual, pemaksaan hubungan seksual dengan tidak wajar atau tidak disukai, pemaksaan hubungan dengan orang lain untuk tujuan komersial dan/atau tujuan tertentu.
(4) Bentuk kekerasan ekonomi sebagaimana dimaksud  pada ayat (1) huruf c berupa penelantaran perempuan  dalam bentuk tidak memberikan kehidupan, perawatan atau pemeliharaan secara layak.
(5) Bentuk kekerasan psikis sebagaimana dimaksud pada  ayat (1) huruf d berupa perbuatan yang mengakibatkan ketakutan, hilangnya rasa percaya diri, hilangnya kemampuan untuk bertindak, rasa tidak berdaya  dan/atau penderitaan psikis berat pada seseorang.
(6) Setiap perempuan korban kekerasan harus mendapat  perlindungan sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan  perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 30
(1) Forms of violence against women include: a. physical violence;
b. sexual violence;
c. economic violence; and
d. psychological violence.
(2) The form of physical violence as referred to in paragraph (1) letter a is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, fainting and/or causes death.
(3) The form of sexual violence as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b is in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse in an unnatural or unwanted manner, forced intercourse with others for commercial purposes and/or specific purposes.
(4) The form of economic violence as referred to in paragraph (1) letter c is in the form of neglect of women in the form of not providing proper livelihood, care or maintenance.
(5) The form of psychological violence as referred to in paragraph (1) letter d is in the form of acts that result in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and/or severe psychological suffering in a person.
(6) Every woman victim of violence must receive protection in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/awkward rendering in paragraph (2): "unconsciousness and or" should be "fainting and/or" to match "pingsan dan atau".
Meaning drift in paragraph (5): "severe psychological suffering to a person" should be "severe psychological suffering in a person" to match "pada seseorang".

text:
Pasal 31
Setiap korban kekerasan harus mendapat perlindungan sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku.
translated_text:
Article 31
Every victim of violence must receive protection in accordance with the applicable provisions.

text:
Pasal 32
(1) Bentuk perlindungan kekerasan terhadap perempuan meliputi:
a. perlindungan medis;
b. perlindungan hukum;
c. perlindungan medico legal (kedokteran forensik); d. perlindungan ekonomi; dan
e. perlindungan psikis.
(2) Bentuk perlindungan medis sebagaimana dimaksud  pada ayat (1) huruf a berupa perawatan dan pemulihan  luka-luka fisik yang bertujuan untuk pemulihan kondisi  fisik korban yang dilakukan tenaga medis dan  paramedis.
(3) Bentuk perlindungan hukum sebagaimana dimaksud  pada ayat (1) huruf b berupa pelayanan dan  pendampingan untuk membantu korban dalam  menjalani proses hukum dan peradilan.
(4) Bentuk perlindungan medico legal sebagaimana  dimaksud pada ayat (1) huruf c berupa layanan medis  untuk kepentingan pembuktian dibidang hukum.
(5) Bentuk perlindungan ekonomi sebagimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) huruf d berupa layanan untuk ketrampilan dan untuk memberikan akses ekonomi agar Korban kekerasan dapat mandiri.
(6) Bentuk perlindungan psikis sebagimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) huruf e berupa dukungan secara psikologis sehingga korban mempunyai rasa percaya diri,  kekuatan dan kemandirian dalam penyelesaian masalah pendampingan dalam rangka memulihkan kondisi traumatis korban termasuk penyediaan rumah aman untuk melindungi korban dari berbagai ancaman dan intimidasi bagi korban.
translated_text:
Article 32
(1) Forms of protection against violence toward women include:
a. medical protection;
b. legal protection;
c. medico legal protection (forensic medicine);
d. economic protection; and
e. psychological protection.
(2) The form of medical protection as referred to in paragraph (1) letter a is in the form of treatment and recovery of physical injuries aimed at restoring the physical condition of victims carried out by medical personnel and paramedics.
(3) The form of legal protection as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b is in the form of services and assistance to help victims undergo legal and judicial processes.
(4) The form of medico legal protection as referred to in paragraph (1) letter c is in the form of medical services for the purposes of evidence in the field of law.
(5) The form of economic protection as referred to in paragraph (1) letter d is in the form of services for skills and to provide economic access so that victims of violence can be independent.
(6) The form of psychological protection as referred to in paragraph (1) letter e is in the form of psychological support so that victims have self-confidence, strength and independence in problem solving through assistance in order to restore the traumatic condition of victims including the provision of safe houses to protect victims from various threats and intimidation for victims.
qa_issues: Scrambled list formatting in paragraph (1): item d is run together with item c on the same line ("...); d.")
Scrambled/merged list structure: items c and d are combined on one line, obscuring separate lettered points.
Minor meaning drift/unnatural rendering: 'Kantor Kepolisian' should be 'Police Station' (not 'Police Offices').

text:
BAB VIII
PERAN SERTA MASYARAKAT
Pasal 36
(1) Masyarakat dapat berperan serta dalam  penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan dan perlindungan  perempuan.
(2) Peran serta masyarakat sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat dilakukan oleh perorangan, kelompok maupun organisasi sosial kemasyarakatan.
(3) Peran serta masyarakat sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat berbentuk:
a. kerjasama;
b. peran aktif dalam penyusunan kebijakan; dan c. pengaduan/laporan.
(4) Kewajiban dan tanggung jawab masyarakat dalam perlindungan perempuan dilaksanakan melalui kegiatan:
a. melakukan pencegahan berlangsungnya tindak pidana;
b. memberikan perlindungan kepada korban;
c. memberikan pertolongan darurat;
d. membantu proses pengajuan permohonan  penetapan perlindungan; dan
e. memberikan informasi atau melaporkan terjadinya tindak pidana kekerasan kepada aparat penegak hukum.
(5) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai peran serta masyarakat sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3) diatur dalam Peraturan Walikota.
translated_text:
CHAPTER VIII
COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION
Article 36
(1) The community may participate in the implementation of empowerment and protection of women.
(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out by individuals, groups or social community organizations.
(3) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may take the form of:
 a. cooperation;
 b. active role in policy formulation; and
 c. complaints/reports.
(4) The obligations and responsibilities of the community in the protection of women are implemented through activities:
 a. preventing the occurrence of criminal acts;
 b. providing protection to victims;
 c. providing emergency assistance;
 d. assisting in the process of submitting applications for protection orders; and
 e. providing information or reporting the occurrence of criminal acts of violence to law enforcement officials.
(5) Further provisions regarding community participation as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be regulated in a Mayoral Regulation.
qa_issues: Scrambled list structure in Article 36(3): item c is run together with item b on the same line ("and c.") instead of being a separate list item.

text:
BAB IX
PEMANTAUAN DAN EVALUASI
Pasal 37
(1) Pemerintah Kota melaksanakan pemantauan dan evaluasi pelaksanaan kebijakan pemberdayaan dan perlindungan perempuan.
(2) Pelaksanaan pemantauan dan evaluasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan secara berkala untuk menjamin sinergi, kesinambungan dan efektivitas kebijakan.
(3) Hasil pemantauan dan evaluasi digunakan sebagai bahan masukan bagi penyusunan kebijakan, program dan kegiatan tahun berikutnya.
translated_text:
CHAPTER IX
MONITORING AND EVALUATION
Article 37
(1) The City Government conducts monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of women's empowerment and protection policies.
(2) The implementation of monitoring and evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out periodically to ensure synergy, continuity and effectiveness of policies.
(3) The results of monitoring and evaluation are used as input material for the formulation of policies, programs and activities for the following year.

text:
BAB X
PENDANAAN
Pasal 38
Pendanaan pelaksanaan kebijakan, program dan kegiatan pemberdayaan dan perlindungan perempuan bersumber dari Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Daerah, tanggung jawab  sosial lingkungan dan dana lain yang sah dan tidak  mengikat.
translated_text:
CHAPTER X
FUNDING
Article 38
Funding for the implementation of policies, programs and activities for women's empowerment and protection is sourced from the Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget, social and environmental responsibility, and other funds that are lawful and non-binding.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/unnatural term: "environmental social responsibility" should reflect "tanggung jawab sosial lingkungan" as social and environmental responsibility (CSR).

text:
BAB XI
KETENTUAN PENUTUP
Pasal 39
Pada saat Peraturan Daerah ini mulai berlaku, Peraturan  Daerah Kota Pangkalpinang Nomor 6 Tahun 2014 tentang  Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak Korban  Kekerasan (Lembaran Daerah Kota Pangkalpinang Tahun  2014 Nomor 6) sebagaimana telah diubah dengan Peraturan  Daerah Kota Pangkalpinang Nomor 6 Tahun 2018 tentang  Perubahan Atas Peraturan Daerah Kota Pangkalpinang  Nomor 6 Tahun 2014 tentang Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan  Perempuan dan Anak Korban Kekerasan (Lembaran Daerah  Kota Pangkalpinang Tahun 2018 Nomor 6), dicabut dan  dinyatakan tidak berlaku.
translated_text:
CHAPTER XI
CLOSING PROVISIONS
Article 39
At the time this Regional Regulation comes into force, Regional Regulation of Pangkalpinang City Number 6 of 2014 concerning the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence (Regional Gazette of Pangkalpinang City Year 2014 Number 6) as amended by Regional Regulation of Pangkalpinang City Number 6 of 2018 concerning Amendment to Regional Regulation of Pangkalpinang City Number 6 of 2014 concerning the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence (Regional Gazette of Pangkalpinang City Year 2018 Number 6), is revoked and declared invalid.

text:
Pasal 40
Peraturan Daerah ini mulai berlaku pada tanggal  diundangkan.
Agar setiap orang mengetahuinya, memerintahkan  pengundangan Peraturan Daerah ini dengan penempatannya  dalam Lembaran Daerah Kota Pangkalpinang.
Ditetapkan di Pangkalpinang pada tanggal 23 Desember 2020
translated_text:
Article 40
This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.
In order that everyone may know of it, the promulgation of this Regional Regulation is ordered by placing it in the Regional Gazette of Pangkalpinang City.
Enacted in Pangkalpinang on 23 December 2020
